LOF lab: the closer query taking the higher factor with 35/24 against 35/32, the second prediction on the live query, staleness when k changes, and the refused duplicate coordinate
Fitting-mode lab: 4/3 for the reference row against 7/8 for a new query at the same coordinate, retired when the coordinate changes
Kernel lab: the midpoint outside at gamma 1 with a disconnected accepted region, inside at gamma 0.1 with one interval, and a reference anchor exactly on the boundary at both
Review-queue lab: 1,079 alerts at 7.4143% precision, precision rising with prevalence alone, and an undefined precision when nobody is flagged

Temperature lab: the 0.975 isolation threshold with 4,263 unmatched alerts and four window hits, the baseline at 1,036, a typed threshold snapped to a precomputed level, window paging against the annotation timestamps, and the published eight-row table
